{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
df_new_paid_search = df[(df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Check if there are any such records
if df_new_paid_search.empty:
    print('No records found for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH.')
else:
    # Calculate the fraction of converted customers
    fraction_converted = df_new_paid_search['converted'].mean()
    
    # Print the result
    fraction_converted"}
